entities.name: Sun-Dappled Court
entities.description: A topiary garden in Valeron on Bant, with thuja trees and the Twelve Trees of Valeron.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: Kingdom ruled justly by the families of the court.

entities.name: Twelve Trees of Valeron
entities.description: Sculpted olive trees each representing a noble bloodline.

entities.name: Sword of Asha
entities.description: Buried beneath the trees before being dug up and reforged.
